## Wolfspeed Inc. (WOLF) `[Power & Wide-Bandgap]`
- Wolfspeed closed at **$35.16**, up **13.19%** on **October 2, 2026**, with **7.35 million shares** traded. (Investing.com, Oct 4 12:24 ET)[7]
- Wolfspeed announced commercial availability of a **Premium 200 mm n-type silicon-carbide substrate** on **September 27, 2026**, with fewer than **0.01 micropipes per cm²** and fewer than **3 micropipes per wafer**; the product was described as immediately orderable with dedicated capacity. (Wolfspeed company release, Sep 27; reported Oct 2 16:12 ET)[6]
- The new substrate expands Wolfspeed’s **200 mm silicon-carbide portfolio** and is designed to reduce defects and improve wafer-shape stability, potentially supporting manufacturing yield. (Moomoo, Oct 2 21:05 ET)[14]
- The broader semiconductor group also advanced after **Micron** reported earnings that fueled a sector-wide rally; the available report identified Micron’s results as the lead group catalyst but did not provide Micron’s specific price move. (Moomoo, Oct 2 21:05 ET)[12]
- Wolfspeed’s fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 AI-data-center revenue was reported as **more than double year over year** and approximately **20% higher sequentially**; the company also reported approximately **$1.1 billion** of cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments as of **June 28, 2026**. (Quiver Quantitative, Oct 2; updated Oct 5 07:26 ET)[5]
- Wolfspeed’s reported short interest was approximately **26.1 million shares**, or **49.6% of public float**, as of **September 15, 2026**. (Quiver Quantitative, Oct 2; updated Oct 5 07:26 ET)[5]
- Wolfspeed’s **October 2 close** was reported at **$35.16**, compared with a median 12-month analyst price target of **$28** from **two analysts**. (TickerNerd, Oct 2; publication time not stated)[15]
- Wolfspeed was identified as having **49.31% short interest** and the highest short interest among technology companies with market capitalizations below **$2 billion** in the cited October 2 data. (GuruFocus, Oct 2 17:32 ET)[13]
- Wolfspeed’s stock was quoted at **$35.12**, up **$3.95**, or **12.67%**, at **09:24 ET on October 5**; the cited report did not identify a new company-specific announcement for that move. (MarketBeat, Oct 5 09:24 ET)[1]
- No specific **after-hours or pre-market October 5 catalyst** was identified in the available reports through **12:20 ET**.
